entities.name: Enthril
entities.description: A Prodigal Sorcerer from Tolaria West who worked as a ship's mage and vanished after casting a chaotic Eternal Dominion spell.

entities.name: Kellan Boldt
entities.description: A young wizard traveling to learn applied magics who escaped on a hot-air balloon.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: The academy where Enthril graduated and Kellan was headed.

entities.name: Perimeter of the Dire Waves
entities.description: A deadly storm-tossed area of the sea crossed by the ship.

entities.name: Scourge of Fleets
entities.description: A giant kraken that smashed the ship.

events.summary: Enthril and Kellan kept pirates at bay long enough for the ship to cross the Perimeter of the Dire Waves, causing the pirates to abandon the chase.
events.quote: This caused the pirates to abandon their chase.

events.summary: A giant kraken smashed the ship; wounded Enthril cast a chaotic Eternal Dominion spell that turned the ship into a hot-air balloon so Kellan alone floated away, and Enthril disappeared.
